SELECT id, transaction_at, description, transaction_type, transaction_institution, account_number, amount, balance_after, memo, category_id, cashflow_type, is_fixed, source_type, payment_method, recurrence_type, memo_owner, memo_target_year_month, memo_parse_status, classification_status, fixed_status, recurrence_pattern_key FROM home_project.transaction_history WHERE transaction_at >= #{searchParam.startDateTime} AND transaction_at < #{searchParam.endDateTimeExclusive} ORDER BY transaction_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{searchParam.limit} OFFSET #{searchParam.offset}

SELECT th.id, th.transaction_at, th.description, th.amount, th.memo, th.cashflow_type, th.category_id, ac.name AS category_name, th.recurrence_type, th.memo_owner, th.classification_status, th.recurrence_pattern_key FROM home_project.transaction_history th LEFT JOIN home_project.account_category ac ON ac.id = th.category_id WHERE th.memo IS NOT NULL AND th.memo <> '' AND th.classification_status IN ('MANUAL', 'AUTO') ORDER BY CASE WHEN th.classification_status = 'MANUAL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, th.transaction_at DESC, th.id DESC LIMIT 10;
